(II) ISSUE A WRIT OR ANY OTHER APPROPRIATE ORDER OR DIRECTION RESTRAINING THE RESPONDENTS FROM INTERFERING WITH DAY TODAY BUSINESS OF THE PETITIONERS VIZ., HOTEL SHRI PANJURLI, HOTEL VINAYAK VEG AND NON VEG AND SHREE CHINESE FAST FOOD CENTER AT OLD HUBLI, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY & (III) GRANT SUCH OTHER RELIEF'S AS THIS HON'BLE COURT DEEMS FIT IN Vijay S/O Piniya Poojari vs The State Of Karnataka on 20 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173969996/

 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:16994  WP No. 106364 of 2024 CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP SINGH YERUR  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP SINGH YERUR) 
1. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Petitioner Nos.1, 2 and 3 are carrying out hotel/restaurant in the name and style of Hotel Shri Panjurli, Hotel Vinayak Veg & Non-Veg and Shree Chinese Fast Food Centre. Petitioners have obtained necessary licence from the Hubballi Dharwad Municipal Corporation and the trade licence is valid up till 31.03.2028 and 31.03.2029 respectively for petitioner Nos.1 and 2. The establishments of the petitioners are registered under the Food Safety and Security Act, 2006 and have obtained GSTIN number, as required. 
3. The hotel/restaurant of the petitioners commence at 12.00 a.m. (noon) and would be open till 12.30 midnight. However, the customers are allowed till 12.00 midnight which fact was brought to the notice of NC: 2024:KHC-D:16994 respondent No.3 through e-mail communication. The petitioners' hotel/restaurant comes within the jurisdiction of respondent No.3 i.e., the Circle Inspector, Hubli Sub- Urban Police Station and the restaurant/hotel of respondent No.3 comes within the jurisdiction of respondent No.4-Circle Inspector, Old Hubli Police Station, Hubli. 
4. This being the state of affairs, police personals attached to the respondent Nos.3 and 4-police stations have been repeatedly coming to the hotel/restaurant of the petitioners and threatening to close the hotel/restaurant at 11.00 p.m. It is the grievance of the petitioners that they should be permitted to run the hotel/restaurant without any bar or time limitation. It is also contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the bar and restaurants run till midnight even up till 1.00 a.m., whereas the officers of the respondent Nos.3 and 4-police stations are coming to the hotels/restaurants and deliberately forcing out the staff and customers from NC:
2024:KHC-D:16994 the hotel/restaurant which is causing severe damage, irreparable financial loss and reputation of the hotel/restaurant of the petitioners. It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that in similar situation, owner of Shanti Sagar Juice Centre who was similarly compelled and forced to close his business by 10.00 p.m. by the police officials, challenged the same by filing Writ Petition No.80105/2013 and this Court vide order dated 31.07.2013 disposed of the Vijay S/O Piniya Poojari vs The State Of Karnataka on 20 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173969996/
3 matter with a direction to the respondents not to restrict the business hours of the juice centre. 
5. It is the grievance of the petitioners that respondent Nos.3 and 4-authorities and its officials are acting without any authority of law and there being no rules, regulations or enactment to shut down or close the business and running of the hotel/restaurant at 10.00 or 11.00 p.m. are unauthorizedly and illegally, with ill-motive and malafide intention, threatening the petitioners to close down their business at 11.00 p.m. It is the contention of NC: 2024:KHC-D:16994 the learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioners are dependant on this sole source of business as income for their livelihood, and many of its customers regular or otherwise, have been relishing/savouring the delicacies prepared by the petitioners at their hotel/restaurant and more over it is after 7.00 to 8.00 p.m. till about 1.00 in the midnight the customers keep coming to the restaurant for having their dinner/meals. Therefore, the respondent Nos.3 and 4 who do not have any manner of right under any provisions of law, should be directed not to interfere running of the business, the hotel/restaurant of the petitioners. 
6. Petitioners have right to free trade in accordance with the rules and regulations prevailing without violating any conditions and it is their fundamental right guaranteed under Article 19(1)(g)
of the Constitution of India to trade and profession and liberty. Therefore the petitioners aggrieved by the threat initiated by respondent Nos.3 and 4 are before this Court.

8. The memo dated 19.09.2024 issued by the Commissioner of the Municipal Administration in respect of NC: 2024:KHC-D:16994 different licence throughout the State of Karnataka with effect from 26.08.2009 as per the communication with regard to running of hotel/business is permitted till 1.00 a.m. as submitted by the learned AGA. 
9. Under the circumstances, the petitioners who are running hotel/restaurant be entitled to run business till 1.00 a.m. without being disturbed by respondent Nos.3 and 4 authorities or its officials. 
10. In view of the above, I pass the following:
ORDER i. This petition is allowed. 
ii. A writ of mandamus is issued directing the respondent-authorities not to restrict the business hours of the petitioners namely Hotel Shri Panjurli, Hotel Vinayak Veg & Non-Veg and Shree Chinese Fast Food Centre at Old Hubballi in accordance with the Rules and Regulations NC: 2024:KHC-D:16994 more so as per the official memorandum dated 19.09.2024, which permits till 1.00 a.m. Sd/-
